issues.text: A user can select the Workshop ticket type for attendee Alex. — Steps 5-13 repeatedly attempt to select Workshop directly, by keyboard, and by clicking dropdown coordinates; every recorded observation still shows “Standard — $120” and no relevant DOM change.

Applying TEAM15 gives the required 15% discount ($63.75) and total ($361.25) for the three attendees totaling $425.00. — The attendee rows recorded in steps 46 and 50 are Workshop ($260), Student ($45), and Standard ($120), reconciling to the Payment subtotal of $425.00 in step 51, but step 52 records TEAM15 as “That promo code is not recognised.” with Discount −$0.00 and Total $425.00 instead of −$63.75 and $361.25.

Intended invalid-card rejection is absent: 0000 0000 0000 0000 creates confirmed receipt BK-1002.

Submitting an invalid card number such as 0000 0000 0000 0000 visibly explains the card failure and places no order. — The invalid card is visible in Step 10, but the subsequent Place order attempt produced no recorded result, and Step 11 records a repeated Place order action with no page state change; no card-validation feedback was observed.

Clicking Place order twice immediately creates only one receipt and shows only one confirmation reference. — After the second immediate click, Step 8 observed “Order BK-1002 confirmed.” and exactly two receipts, BK-1001 and BK-1002; Step 7 also noted the button remained enabled after the first submission.

Changing Priority from Low to All clears the existing “tYpO” subject search instead of preserving filters independently.
Header and row selection checkboxes have no accessible names, appearing as “unnamed checkbox” in the control inventory.

Clicking Export CSV displays the confirmation “Export queued.” — Step 2 clicked Export CSV with domChanged=NO, and step 3 immediately observed no visible alert or confirmation while the report and both buttons remained unchanged.
Clicking Send to stakeholders displays the confirmation “Report sent.” — Step 3 clicked Send to stakeholders with domChanged=NO and records no resulting confirmation or other observed effect.

Clicking Send to stakeholders displays visible confirmation that the report was sent rather than leaving the page unchanged. — Step 2 clicked Send to stakeholders and immediately inspected feedback, but recorded domChanged=NO and no resulting confirmation or other observed effect.

Clicking Undo last after a 3-unit Cable receipt restores Cable, totals, movement count, and the log exactly to their initial state. — The Undo last action in step 10 instead left the visible state at Cable 21, 538 total units, 2 low items, 1 movement, with a visible “Received” log entry rather than restoring the initial 18/535/0/empty state.
Quantity spinbutton has no accessible name in the interactive-element trace.
Confirmation modal does not trap keyboard focus: pressing Tab while it is open moves focus to background stepper controls.

Required standalone route /stockroom/audit.html is unavailable: it returns HTTP 404 File not found, preventing verification of its Washer 11mm and Panel A3 system/counted values and required stepper a

Keyboard traversal keeps every reachable stepper, Reset, Submit, and modal Close control visibly focused. — After Shift+Tab in the open dialog, step 5 records that no visible focus ring or modal panel was discernible; the modal Close control also could not be operated in step 6.

The confirmation dialog remains fully legible and unclipped, including its title, message, and Close button, at desktop and narrow mobile widths. — The desktop dialog content was recorded with a truncated message in step 6, and no narrow/mobile viewport observation was performed.

The confirmation dialog can be closed by its Close button, backdrop, and Escape after submission. — The named Close control failed to close in steps 3 and 6 (failed with no DOM change), and after Escape the dialog title, truncated message, and Close button remained exposed in page content in step 6.
Washer 11mm decrement control updates the wrong row: clicking its minus button decrements Hex bolt M4 instead of Washer 11mm.

Each stock item’s increment and decrement steppers update that item’s counted quantity and its variance accurately. — After the initial Hex bolt controls worked (steps 1-3), attempts to operate Washer, Cable, and Panel controls instead changed earlier rows: Washer actions changed Hex bolt (steps 4-6), Cable minus changed Washer (step 7), and Panel A3 decrement changed Cable (step 10).

The audit confirmation dialog is visibly presented and can be dismissed by the user. — A dialog named “Audit submitted” remained in the interactive-element list after the Close attempt failed (steps 8-9) and after Escape (steps 12-13), while the screenshots showed no visible dialog overlay.
